name: LSDJ square drive
desc: Chiptune pulse bass in Eb major: driving octave eighths over an Eb-Cm-Ab-Bb progression, pure Game Boy LSDJ energy with a filter that opens as the level rises. Peak gallops into sixteenth octave bounces.

code.sparse: note("<[eb2 ~ eb1 ~ eb2 ~ ~ ~] [c2 ~ c1 ~ c2 ~ ~ ~] [ab1 ~ ab2 ~ ab1 ~ ~ ~] [bb1 ~ bb2 ~ bb1 ~ ~ ~]>").add(note(${root})).s("square").attack(.004).decay(.15).sustain(.25).release(.05).lpf(${cut}*.7).gain(${gain}*.85).orbit(3).play()
code.full: note("<[eb2 eb1 eb2 eb1 eb2 eb1 eb2 eb1] [c2 c1 c2 c1 c2 c1 c2 c1] [ab1 ab2 ab1 ab2 ab1 ab2 ab1 ab2] [bb1 bb2 bb1 bb2 bb1 bb2 bb1 d2]>").add(note(${root})).s("square").attack(.003).decay(.12).sustain(.22).release(.04).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.7, ${cut}*1.3).slow(16)).gain(${gain}).orbit(3).play()
code.peak: note("<[eb2 eb1 eb2 eb1 eb2 eb1 eb2 eb1] [c2 c1 c2 c1 c2 c1 c2 c1] [ab1 ab2 ab1 ab2 ab1 ab2 ab1 ab2] [bb1 bb2 bb1 bb2 bb1 bb2 g2 d2]>").add(note(${root})).s("square").attack(.002).decay(.1).sustain(.2).release(.03).lpf(${cut}*1.4).gain(${gain}).ply(2).lastOf(8, x=>x.rev()).orbit(3).play()
